documents.text:
INC-2203 Cryostat helium level alarm
[Synthetic example written for this benchmark; all names, numbers and events are fictional.]

Beamline B2 log, 2 May. The sample cryostat helium level fell to 18 percent overnight and the low-level alarm paged the on-call scientist. Root cause: a transfer line valve left half open after refill. The refill checklist now includes a valve position check.

documents.title: INC-2211 Cryostat cold-head vibration spike
documents.text:
INC-2211 Cryostat cold-head vibration spike
[Synthetic example written for this benchmark; all names, numbers and events are fictional.]

Beamline B2 log, 9 May. Vibration at the cryostat cold head rose fivefold and smeared diffraction spots for three hours. Root cause: a loose mounting bolt on the compressor skid. The bolts were torqued and a vibration limit was added to monitoring.

documents.title: INC-2230 Vacuum gauge VG-7 pressure spike
documents.text:
INC-2230 Vacuum gauge VG-7 pressure spike
[Synthetic example written for this benchmark; all names, numbers and events are fictional.]

Beamline B2 log, 14 May. Gauge VG-7 showed a spike to 3e-5 mbar that tripped the fast valve. Root cause: a contaminated gauge filament giving false readings. The gauge was degassed and cross-checked against VG-8.

documents.title: INC-2236 Vacuum pump P-2 overheating trip
documents.text:
INC-2236 Vacuum pump P-2 overheating trip
[Synthetic example written for this benchmark; all names, numbers and events are fictional.]

Beamline B2 log, 21 May. Turbo pump P-2 tripped on over-temperature during a long scan. Root cause: a clogged cooling-water strainer. The strainer was cleaned and added to the monthly maintenance list.

documents.title: INC-2248 Radiation interlock door switch fault
documents.text:
INC-2248 Radiation interlock door switch fault
[Synthetic example written for this benchmark; all names, numbers and events are fictional.]

Beamline B2 log, 25 May. The hutch door interlock reported open while the door was closed, blocking beam delivery. Root cause: a worn door switch actuator. The actuator was replaced and the interlock chain was re-certified.

documents.title: INC-2251 Interlock key-tag mismatch at hutch entry
documents.text:
INC-2251 Interlock key-tag mismatch at hutch entry
[Synthetic example written for this benchmark; all names, numbers and events are fictional.]

Beamline B2 log, 28 May. The search-and-secure sequence failed because a key tag did not match the key-bank record. Root cause: a key returned to the wrong slot. Key slots were relabelled and the procedure now requires a second check.
